items.title: File Einspruch (objection) against the Bußgeldbescheid
items.quote: Er muss zwei Wochen nach der Zustellung beim Landkreis Musteruckermark – Bußgeldstelle vorliegen, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift.
items.computation: The letter was formally served (Zustellungsurkunde, § 182 ZPO); the service receipt on page 2 is marked 'zugestellt am 24.11.2026', so no deemed-delivery rule applies — 24.11.2026 is the actual delivery day. Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of delivery itself is not counted, so the two-week Einspruch period (§ 67 Abs. 1 OWiG in conjunction with § 43 StPO, § 46 Abs. 1 OWiG) starts on 25.11.2026. Two weeks later (§ 188 Abs. 1, 2 BGB) is 08.12.2026, a Tuesday, which is a normal working day in Brandenburg (no public holiday that week), so the deadline is not shifted. The objection must actually be received by the Bußgeldstelle by this date (not just postmarked).

items.title: Pay the fine, fee and delivery costs (total)
items.quote: Fällig wird der Betrag zwei Wochen, nachdem der Bescheid rechtskräftig geworden ist.
items.computation: Payment falls due two weeks after the Bescheid becomes rechtskräftig (final). It becomes final only if no Einspruch is filed within the two-week objection period, which ends 08.12.2026 (see other item). Assuming no objection is filed, finality (Rechtskraft) occurs the next calendar day, 09.12.2026. Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the two-week payment period then starts the day after that, 10.12.2026, and two weeks later (§ 188 Abs. 1, 2 BGB) is 23.12.2026, a Wednesday and a normal working day in Brandenburg, so no weekend/holiday shift applies. This date is conditional: if an Einspruch is filed by 08.12.2026, the fine does not become final on this schedule and this payment deadline does not apply.

warnings: The payment due date (23.12.2026) is only valid if no Einspruch is filed by the 08.12.2026 deadline; filing an objection stops this payment deadline and starts separate court proceedings instead.

The letter's delivery-receipt page (page 2) shows a formal postal service (Postzustellungsurkunde, § 182 ZPO) with a handwritten delivery date of 24.11.2026 that exactly matches today's date as given — this specific date should be checked against the person's actual envelope/receipt rather than assumed.

An IBAN check confirms DE92 1705 6060 0001 7291 00 is a well-formed German IBAN, but this only verifies the format, not that the account truly belongs to the Bußgeldstelle; use only the bank details on this official notice and verify through the authority's known contact channels if in doubt.
